title: Snail Mob
description: A snail named Jeffery is out to avenge his wife Jeffica. You brutally murdered her by stepping on her the moment you spawned in. He touches you, you die.
body:
# Snail Mob

**You crushed his wife. Now Jeffery is coming for you.**

The moment you spawned into this world, your boot came down on a small, fragile creature named **Jeffica**. You didn't notice. You walked on.

Her husband noticed.

**Jeffery** is a snail. Jeffery is slow. Jeffery is *inevitable.*

He has crossed mountains for you. He has swum oceans for you. He has followed you into the Nether and out the other side. He moves at half a block per second. He will never stop. He will never sleep. And if he ever — *ever* — catches up to you, the message in chat will read:

> Jeffery got his revenge on you while you were trying to escape Skeleton.

---

## How it works

When you join a world, Jeffery spawns just out of sight and begins his slow, deliberate march toward your exact coordinates. He doesn't path around obstacles the way other mobs do — he is *bound* to you. Build walls. Dig holes. Sail away. He's still coming.

If you outrun him by enough blocks, he enters a **dormant simulation mode** — the chunks around him unload, but his position continues advancing toward you in the background. The moment you slow down, or sleep, or build a base… he closes the gap.

When he touches you, you die. There is no fighting him. There is no negotiating. There is only running.

---

## Items & blocks

You are not entirely defenseless — you just can't *win.* You can only stay informed.

| Item | What it does |
|---|---|
| **Snail Locator** | A compass that points to Jeffery's current position. The needle never lies. |
| **Snail Sensor** | A Geiger-counter-style detector that clicks faster as he gets closer. Silent at long range; frantic when he's outside your door. |
| **Snail Tracking Map** | A map item with a live decoration that follows Jeffery across the world. |
| **Snail Beacon** | A placed block that fires a vertical beam of light from Jeffery's position — but only when he's within 100 blocks (configurable). An early-warning system for the inevitable. |
| **Jeffica's Remains** | The flattened shell of his wife. Dropped at world spawn. A keepsake. A reminder. |

---

## Configuration

Everything is tunable from the in-game config screen (also hot-reloads from the `.toml` file with no restart):

- **Snail speed** — default 0.5 blocks/sec. Crank to 5 for nightmare mode, or down to a crawl for a slow-burn campaign.
- **Initial spawn distance** — how far away Jeffery starts on a fresh world.
- **Dormancy threshold** — distance at which Jeffery enters simulated pursuit (saves performance).
- **Creative immunity** — toggle whether creative/spectator players are safe (default: yes).
- **Distance broadcast messages** — periodic "the snail is X blocks away" chat messages. Disable for a stealthier, more terrifying experience.
- **Sensor click ranges & rates** — full control over how loud and how soon the Snail Sensor reacts.
- **Beacon beam visibility range** — radius around the beacon within which Jeffery's beam appears.
- **Master enable/disable** — turn the entire mod off without uninstalling. All snails despawn cleanly.

---

## Compatibility

- **Mod loader:** NeoForge
- **Minecraft versions:** 1.21, 1.21.1, 1.21.2, 1.21.3, 1.21.4, 1.21.5, 1.21.6, 1.21.7, 1.21.8, 1.21.10, 1.21.11, 26.1, 26.1.1, 26.1.2
  *(1.21.9 not supported.)*
- **Singleplayer and multiplayer:** server-side install required; client install adds the optional in-game config screen and item-model needles.

---

## Notes

- Jeffery persists through death, sleep, world reload, dimension change, and chunk unload. He is permanent.
- Each player gets their own Jeffery. He is *your* snail. He is hunting *you.*
- This is a beta release. If Jeffery does something especially memorable to you, tell us about it in an email krookedlilly@gmail.com

*All that's left of Jeffica…*

If you enjoy this mod, please check out our other games and apps at [KrookedLilly.com](https://krookedlilly.com)
